verdict.rationale: Square is a closed-source SaaS platform; while its SDKs (e.g. square-nodejs-sdk) are open on GitHub, the core product (payments platform, dashboard, APIs) is proprietary and no evidence shows the product's source is available under an open license. missing for 10: any statement of an open-source license for the core Square product/platform, only client SDKs are open which is a different axis.
